relevant_laws.quote: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner.
relevant_laws.notes: A residence-district crosswalk can be traversed by the fixed reverse task. Conditions remain explicit: Establish eligible vehicle classification and driver attribution.; Establish the residence-district setting, highway boundaries, and distinctly marked pedestrian crossing.; Highway boundaries and a distinctly marked pedestrian crossing.; Residence-district setting and qualifying motor vehicle with identified driver.; Retain time-aligned vehicle extent, motion, and crosswalk geometry without selecting a legal boundary-contact rule.; Specify physically supported backing on or over the crosswalk.; Supported backing route on or over the crosswalk.; Time-aligned vehicle footprint, motion and crosswalk geometry.
